 Most recent Most popular get involved Get Involved published at 19:36 GMT 19:36 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' to have your say 
 616 days since Tottenham won three league games on the spin.... And we're in the top half, I think I've got a nose bleed from the altitude!
 Tom, Stoke 
 84 5 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'We want to be back at the top again' published at 19:34 GMT 19:34 GMT 
 FT: Tottenham 2-0 Crystal Palace 
 Tottenham Hotspur 
 Tottenham goalscorer Jan Paul van Hecke, speaking to Sky Sports: "Really good, really happy. This is the result we wanted. Of course it helps when they get a red card but we stayed calm, created a lot of chances, it took a while before we scored the second one but it was a good game, we were solid and I'm happy with three points.
 We knew before the game they have a really low block and its hard to play through them, we had to be patient and find a gap, we could have scored more but I'm happy."
 On his goal: "When I had it first I thought it was a great save, then it came back to my head and I got it in, I am really happy. I was lucky the ball came back."
 On working under Roberto De Zerbi again: "He's a top, top manager. I have a really good relationship with him. He gets the best out of me and there is a lot more to come from us so its really exiting."
 "When you win games the confidence is growing. When you keep clean sheets that is really positive. At the beginning of the season we played well but didn't win games, that's football. We needed to stay calm and we did. Now we need to stay calm and keep going and win a lot of games because we want to be back at the top again."
 46 12 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Villa on a great run' published at 19:33 GMT 19:33 GMT 
 Aston Villa v Fulham (20:00 GMT) 
 I am not surprised that Fulham's Premier League form has picked up because after watching them earlier in the season I thought they should have more points than they had.
 The Cottagers are a well-structured team but I still don't see them stopping an in-form Aston Villa, or their striker Nicolas Jackson, at this moment in time.
 Villa are on a great run in the league and I am expecting more goal action from Jackson here.
 Sutton's prediction: 3-1 
 24 12 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 19:31 GMT 19:31 GMT 
 Right, we move onto our final game of the longest day ever. We'll bring you some reaction plus build up as we have it.
 If you've been with us since the 12.30 kick-off, which feels a long time ago now, then congratulations and thanks for keeping us company.
 Perhaps some of you are using this gap to quickly take the kids trick or treating. Pick yourselves up some snacks for this late kick-off, maybe.
 Will it be a trick or a treat of a night for Aston Villa or Fulham?
